articles.summary: We turned what we learned from hundreds of migrations into mint migrate, so your agent can move your docs from 21 platforms, prove nothing went missing, and tell you what didn't carry over.
articles.title: Migrate to Mintlify with your agent

articles.summary: We built a CLI command that gives coding agents current Mintlify guidance, and at first it changed nothing. One line in AGENTS.md, plus tighter guidance, took Claude Sonnet's pass rate on our hardest tasks from about one in five to every run.
articles.title: We gave agents better instructions

articles.summary: We watched agents struggle through Mintlify setup, fetching multiple pages, trying wrong commands, and sending long instructions. So we built setup.md, one starting point for getting connected.
articles.title: We built one page to help AI agents set up Mintlify
